description_en: Queries a list of authorization rules of a bastion host
description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机下授权规则列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-rules --instance-id bastionhost-cn-5yd34ol020a --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRules

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the authorization rule to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的授权规则名称。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The state of the authorization rule to query.

Enabled

Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的授权规则状态。
Enabled：正常
Disabled：已禁用
parameters.name: rule_state

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Rules.description_en: The authorization rules that are returned
Rules.description_zh: 查询到的授权规则列表

Comment.description_en: The remarks of the authorization rule

EffectiveEndTime.description_en: The end time of the validity period of the authorization rule. The value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds
EffectiveEndTime.description_zh: 授权规则有效期结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）

EffectiveStartTime.description_en: The start time of the validity period of the authorization rule. The value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds
EffectiveStartTime.description_zh: 授权规则有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）

RuleName.description_en: The name of the authorization rule

RuleState.description_en:
The state of the authorization rule.

Enabled

Disabled
RuleState.description_zh:
授权规则状态。
Enabled：正常
Disabled：已禁用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of authorization rules that are returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的授权规则总数量
